ir_check.note: Placeholder. One real IR frame to be captured; night/IR is untested and not claimed.

model_card.inputs: 17 COCO keypoints per person from YOLO26n-pose, torso-scaled; no faces, no identities
model_card.windows: 1 s windows, stride 0.5 s; pairwise person features (distance, approach speed, wrist speed, arm height)
model_card.classifier: Random forest / LightGBM on window features; types are rules on top of the score
model_card.split: GroupKFold by video; clip-level precision / recall / AUC; calibrated
model_card.threshold: Tuned on own venue footage for ≤1 false alarm per camera-hour; 1 s persistence; tense is silent
failure_modes: Tracker ID swaps mid-fight (we score pairs, not IDs)

disclosure: Placeholder. Dataset numbers come from public phone-video clips on a video-level split; live-room numbers come from our own venue footage and are lower. We detect physical aggression and crowding only; we do not claim verbal or online bullying, and night/IR is untested.
